current_coverage_state.note: Both owner-directed archaeology gates are completed_verified. Future routed PCV convergence/installed-proof work remains ordinary governed implementation and is not silently absorbed into archaeology.

reconstruction_policy.rule: Missing verbatim source is not a reason to leave a project-memory gap. Reconstruct the most evidence-consistent complete answer from surviving sources, chronology, dependencies, inherited behavior, implementation evidence and supersession chains.
reconstruction_policy.prohibition: Do not invent arbitrary unsupported detail or present reconstructed material as verbatim source.
reconstruction_policy.unresolved_threshold: Use indeterminate/unresolved_archaeology only when active reconstruction still leaves materially different plausible interpretations that cannot responsibly be selected from available evidence.
reconstruction_policy.later_contradiction_handling: revise_or_supersede_explicitly; never silently erase the prior reconstruction
reconstruction_policy.owner_ratification: Owner/final authority may promote, correct, or replace any reconstruction.

chronology.name: Preformal giant text-dump / Rubik's-cube source state
chronology.summary: No current artifact literally named Rubik's cube survives. The preformal source layer is accounted for through the complete four-archive legacy corpus and later Phase 1–8 converted descendants; no byte-identical equivalence is claimed.

chronology.name: Phase 0 — legacy source creation
chronology.summary: Original rules, abilities, creatures, items, settings, adventures, world material and supporting prose created by John Brandon Turner and his brother.

chronology.name: Phase 0.5 — Multiversal Definition
chronology.summary: Defined Multiversal as a broad multi-genre, multi-setting, modular tabletop platform with Player/GM workflows, extensible packs and AI assistance.

chronology.name: Phase 8 — canonicalization and validation
chronology.summary: Converted accumulated design/recovered source into governed standards, canonical structures, validated content and regression/balance infrastructure.

chronology.name: Phase 9 — architecture and bounded implementation readiness
chronology.summary: Established provider-neutral architecture and bounded readiness later consumed by implementation families.

chronology.name: Post-phase / pre-family interstitial work
chronology.summary: Stage A, Internal Alpha, content/source recovery and repository-hardening work are inventoried and dispositioned.

chronology.name: Tranche-family era
chronology.summary: All 83 application-planning directories and 662 unique work items across 667 attempt files receive explicit dispositions; PDCP reductions remain preserved.

chronology.name: OPS3 / current convergence
chronology.summary: OPS3 remains the live selector; PCV-01/02 are complete, PCV-03 is current, PCV-04+ remain predecessor-blocked.

pcv_candidate_specific_wiring_gate.reason: Owner-directed deeper audit found candidate/predecessor wiring gaps after global archaeology closeout.
